title: Surface council-root vs data-root distinction in the frame section
brief: brief: In GLOSSARY under "Council" (or as a small "Council root vs council data root" sub-entry under The frame), add the one-sentence mental model from paths.ts:36-42 / data-model.md:3-11 / SPEC: the directory you run `npx landsraad` from is the council root (product tree + adapter cwd); the council's own machine state lives under `.landsraad/` (councilDataRoot).
